name: Mercenary Witch Pyre
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Witch Pyre (players/witch_hunter/mercenary/pyre_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): health 500 (700); armor/resistance 25 (30); explosion 100 (120); mana 125 (115). Its own mana 125 (115), cooldown 15 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: The pyre (7.5 s) has 500 health and 25 armor and resistance; enemies that hit it set off 100 magical damage.
